high_level_description: This image is a tweet from the official Twitter account of Narendra Modi (@narendramodi), the Prime Minister of India. The tweet is dated September 3, 2024, at 3:53 PM. The content of the tweet reads: "Landed in Brunei Darussalam. Looking forward to strong ties between our nations, especially in boosting commercial and cultural linkages. I thank Crown Prince His Royal Highness Prince Haji Al-Muhtadee Billah for welcoming me at the airport."
